about_the_game:
Aaron Gwynaire

Aaron Gwynaire composed tracks for the Neyyah world, as well as directing the overall energy and vibe which would inevitably help elevate and enrich the overall gaming experience. With a background in music production and singer/ songwriting / performing, it was a welcome break from the other tasks involved in making Neyyah a reality, and a chance to return to those music roots. Aaron Gwynaire mainly used a Yamaha PSR E463 to record the tracks he provided for the game. 

Zaedyn Turner

Zaedyn Turner has written and recorded original music for a number of projects and events including GoSH Hackathon, Coder Dojo, and Perth Poetry Festival. In addition to working on his own projects, Zaedyn contributed to 55 tracks on the Neyyah OST.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Storage: 220 MB available space
  • Storage (high-quality audio): Additional 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: MP3 and WAV

short_description: The Neyyah soundtrack includes 83 tracks and has been composed by Aaron Gwynaire and Zaedyn Turner. This musical odyssey helps weave the rich tapestry of the world of Neyyah and takes you on a musical journey lasting more than 2.5 hours.
